answer: Randomized quorum attestation. Each epoch a public verifiable random function draws an unpredictable summit of attesters from the active set; only that drawn committee may attest new identities. Attesters must mirror the applicant's cryptographic commitment and return a signed pulse proving liveness. Because the committee is unknown until the epoch seed is revealed, attackers cannot precompute which agents to compromise, forcing them to subvert many identities blindly.
